Subject: Request: partner-sourced pilot vouchers + compliance attachments

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BlueArch's cohort SI (CloudForge) is excited to kick off a 6-week pilot with one of their enterprise portfolio companies. They're asking if Redwood can allocate partner-sponsored pilot vouchers (trial credits) tied to the SI, so the pilot can run without procurement delays.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a $10k voucher (applied to a dedicated trial org) and a 30-day trial extension window for initial onboarding? The pilot will start the week of Nov 30.

I attached the onboarding checklist and a light SOW (draft) for context. Also looping in CloudForge's technical lead in a follow-up if you need deeper infra details.

Attachments: BA_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx), BA_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

—Elisa

Hi Elisa — appreciate the note and the materials. Quick confirmation items before I route for approval: 

- Voucher amount: $10,000 (we usually escrow as token/credit allocation against a trial org).
- Trial window: 30 days starting on org activation date — we can extend to 60 days only with product ops sign-off.
- Need: partner justification (how BlueArch qualifies for partner-funded vouchers) + basic security attestation so Security can sign off on the dedicated trial org.

Sergio — can you advise on allocation flow (voucher vs trial-topup) and whether we can do the 30-day extension automatically for SI-sourced pilots? If we need SSO or VPC prep, flag it so we can reserve capacity.

If you want to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk through the SOW and activation timeline I can set that up.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Thanks Vanessa / Elisa — quick ops summary and proposed path: 

1) Qualification: BlueArch cohorts are an acceptable partner channel; recommended voucher = $8k initial, hold $2k contingent on usage milestones (security/compliance sign-off + activation within 30 days).
2) Mechanics: create trial org under account BA-2026-PILOT-053, issue a voucher code for $8k applied at first billing, and an option to request the $2k top-up after the milestone.
3) Compliance: need Security to confirm that the trial org configuration (no VPC, standard RBAC) meets their controls. If CloudForge requests VPC or dedicated infra we'll need Dedicated escalation.

Attachments: BA_Security_Attestation.pdf (for Security to review)

Priyom — can you draft the approval note for Finance and include the HubSpot deal link? If Finance signs off, I can convert to a voucher and route the DocuSign for the SOW.

—Sergio
